emptyState.title: No projects yet
emptyState.description: Create a project to group your servers and Units

environment.description: Choose where this project will work.
environment.isolatedHint: This server holds no credentials and can run externally-sourced tasks without approval.
environment.autoSelected: Auto-selected — there was only one option.
environment.noServersAvailable: Every server is already configured for this project. There is nothing left to add.
environment.alreadyAddedError: "{{server}}" is already configured for this project and cannot be added again.

code.pathWillBeCreated: This path does not exist yet. It will be created.
code.cloneNote: This repository will be provisioned via distribution the first time a task runs on this server. Cloning does not happen here.
code.cloneNoteLocal: This repository will be cloned directly into the target directory on the hub, right now.
code.laterNote: Only the environment (server + root) will be created; no repository will be registered.

confirm.alreadyCreatedNotice: Steps already completed are kept. You can retry from the step that failed.

errors.serverTypeUnresolved: Could not determine server "{{server}}"'s type yet — please wait a moment and try again.

general.slugHint: Used as tmux session name. Lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens only.
general.iconHint: Emoji or uploaded image displayed on the project sidebar
general.colorHint: Accent color for the project sidebar icon
general.unitPromptHint: Project-level instructions for all Units. Combined with each Unit's own system prompt.
general.unitPromptPlaceholder: e.g. This is a Next.js application using TypeScript...

general.defaultUnitHint: Used for tasks in this project that don't specify their own Unit.

repositories.tip: Tip: Use the Repositories tab in the activity bar to browse issues.
repositories.tokenHint: Leave empty to use gh CLI authentication

discover.title: Discover Repositories
discover.empty: No git repositories with remotes were found in the working directory.

servers.distributeCodeHint: The hub distributes this project's code to this server on the hub's own credentials, so a dev environment is ready even without git credentials on the server. Defaults off.
servers.distributeCodeIsolatedHint: Isolated servers hold no git credentials of their own, so code distribution is always on and cannot be turned off.
servers.distributionRepositoryHint: Which repository the hub distributes onto this server. Required while distribution is on — never inferred, even when the project has only one repository.
servers.distributionRepositoryRequired: Select a distribution repository — required while distribution is on.
servers.inputPolicyHint: Controls whether tasks imported from an external source (e.g. a GitHub/GitLab issue) may run on this server. Defaults to requiring manual approval.
servers.inputPolicyAllowHint: Runs automatically without approval — only effective on a verified isolated server. Automatically falls back to manual approval when verification is missing, expired, or scoped auth is disabled.

secrets.note: Values registered here are injected as environment variables (AZITO_SECRET_<NAME>) into task execution panes. Only register credentials that are safe to share with agents. Values cannot be retrieved after saving.
secrets.nameValidation: Name must contain only A-Z, 0-9, _ (max 64 chars)
secrets.deleteConfirmMessage: Delete secret "{{name}}"? This cannot be undone.

danger.description: Deleting a project will remove all associated windows and server configurations. Tasks will remain but will no longer be linked to this project.
danger.deleteConfirmMessage: Delete this project? This cannot be undone.
